thread:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] Detected sustained traffic surge for org 'catalyst' (org_id=catalyst-prod). QPS ~3200 (baseline ~420). Elevated P99 and error rate. Auto-scale triggered. Paging on-call: @sophie

sophie: on it. pulling dashboard + traces now. any immediate customer-facing failures reported?

eli: getting traces — seeing large request fanout from a batch job hitting /v1/generate with long prompts. 60% of calls are >2k tokens.

maria: confirming errors: 502s spiking for some tenants; catalyst errors concentrated on model-variant redwood-1. Quantiles look bad at >97th.

jason: recommendation: apply temporary per-org qps cap for catalyst to protect shared pool. Suggest 600 qps and throttle bursts. Who can flip the org cap?

sophie: I can do the hotfix. tagging runbook: apply temporary quota via admin CLI and notify CS.

ops-bot: automated runbook step: set_org_cap --org catalyst-prod --qps 600 --duration 30m

sophie: running now. paste logs:```
$ set_org_cap --org catalyst-prod --qps 600 --reason "emergency surge mitigation" --expires 1710703580
SUCCESS: org catalyst-prod cap set -> 600 qps
```

support: any customer-impact messaging we should send?

cs-amy: CS draft: "We're applying a temporary request cap to mitigate a traffic spike impacting shared capacity. This may slow some of your requests; we're monitoring and will remove the cap as soon as safe." want me to send?

maria: yes send now. Also open to enabling fallback model variant for catalyst to reduce token cost per call.

jason: +1 on fallback — config below to shift 80% traffic to redwood-1-small via routing policy until load normalizes. But need approval for potential quality regression.

eli: metrics after cap: overall p99 latency down 28%, error rate for other tenants back to baseline. catalyst throughput limited as expected.

sophie: I'll keep the cap for 30m and reassess at 15m mark. If Catalyst ops wants more, they need to coordinate for reserved capacity.

ops-bot: schedule check-in: @sophie in 15m. health checks: model serving, queue lengths, KV cache hit-rate.

cs-amy: sent notice to catalyst CSM + account owner. awaiting reply.

support: customer reply: "we see throttling but prefer degraded performance vs full outage — thanks for quick action."

maria: plan for rollback: if error rates stable and latency normal for 5m window, remove cap. Otherwise extend or escalate to capacity team for temporary reserved capacity.

sophie: update: at 15m check-in, p99 stable, no cross-tenant impact. keeping cap but moving to 10m poll cadence.

eli: logging note: filed incident ticket #INC-2026-7842 with root cause hypothesis (large long-prompt batch job + unbounded client retries). Recommend follow-up: quota guidance + adaptive routing.

jason: leaving notes for Billing/Capacity: org consumed unexpected burst; consider outreach about committed capacity options.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: temporary per-org cap applied -> catalyst=600 qps at 1710701234 by sophie. Next check 1710701834.

sophie: closing thread for active mitigation; will reopen if cap extension needed. posting post-incident action items to #postmortems. :white_check_mark:
